title: Strategic setting
detail: Akhaura sat on a strategic eastern approach where local resistance, sector command, and Indian support intersected.

title: Akhaura Front and Battle of Daruin
detail: Fighting around Daruin and Akhaura showed how border-front actions could stretch Pakistani defenses before December.

title: Historical significance
detail: The front links local martyr memory with the wider military geography of Sector 2 and the eastern theatre.
